issues.title: Inconsistent Type Enums between Schema and AC
issues.why: The JSON Schema in 00-overview allows ['string', 'int', 'float', 'bool', 'json'], but AC-SC-14 mandates ['boolean', 'number', 'string', 'select', 'multiselect']. An AI coder will not know which set to implement for the validator.
issues.fix: Align AC-SC-14 and the JSON Schema enum to use the same set of canonical type strings.

issues.title: Missing External Error Code Registry
issues.why: Multiple files reference 'apperror' and specific error codes (e.g., AB-9301, ErrSeedLoadFailed) which are not defined in the provided context, leading to compilation failures in a 'no web access' environment.
issues.fix: Provide a minimal Go 'apperror' package and a const block for all referenced error codes within the module.

issues.title: Ambiguous CHANGELOG.md Write Concurrency
issues.why: AC-SC-11 states the CHANGELOG write is outside the SQL transaction. AC-SC-17 mentions file locks but doesn't specify if the lock must be held during the file append, risking lost updates if two processes commit DB changes and then race to append to the same file.
issues.fix: Explicitly state that the file lock must be acquired before the SQL transaction begins and held until the CHANGELOG write completes.
